name: Hyacinth Mushroom
summary: In Shadowglen, Hyacinth Mushrooms grow at the roots of trees across Teldrassil. Night elf herbalists use them for medicine, and grell and grellkin forage for them.

sections.title: Flora of Shadowglen
sections.body: Hyacinth Mushrooms grow in Shadowglen among the trees and roots of Aldrassil. Forest healers use them in remedies for young night elf sentinels and trainees harmed by venomous creatures. The spiders of Shadowthread Cave are among the dangers they face, and the mushrooms go into soothing draughts and antivenoms. Corrupted grell also hoard them.

faq.q: What are Hyacinth Mushrooms used for?
faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine uses Hyacinth Mushrooms to make an antidote for Iverron, a young night elf poisoned by venomous spiders while exploring Shadowthread Cave.
Hyacinth Mushrooms grow on the ground near large tree trunks and roots, and beside boulders in Shadowglen on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why do the grell carry Hyacinth Mushrooms?
faq.answer: Grell and grellkin in southern Shadowglen forage for Hyacinth Mushrooms and hoard them in their camps.
No. Local healers safely use Hyacinth Mushrooms in healing poultices and antivenoms.

angles.text: Gathering these fungi in Shadowglen takes no formal training. A fledgling herbalist can learn how they help counter forest toxins.
As a young night elf training in Shadowglen, you can gather wild plants like Hyacinth Mushrooms to help sustain your kin.
